title: NgramRL: Accelerating RL Post-Training for Structured Generation via Rollout-Aware N-gram Speculative Decoding
abstract: arXiv:2610.32881v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) post-training improves the reasoning capabilities of large language models, but its cost is dominated by autoregressive rollout generation, which can exceed 70% of training time. Existing speculative-decoding methods are poorly suited to this setting: model-based drafters consume scarce GPU memory and may become misaligned as the policy evolves, while existing model-free methods do not explicitly exploit repetition across training epochs. We observe that recent rollouts of the same prompt provide a high-quality, self-updating draft source. Based on this insight, we propose NgramRL, a per-prompt n-gram drafter constructed from bounded recent rollout history. NgramRL requires no auxiliary model, drafter training, or persistent GPU-resident drafter state, while target-model verification preserves the rollout distribution. To hide CPU cache lookup and scheduling, we further introduce an adaptive fan-out prefetcher

translated_title: NgramRL：通过感知回滚的N-gram投机解码加速结构化生成的强化学习后训练
translated_abstract: 强化学习（RL）后训练能够提升大型语言模型的推理能力，但其成本主要由自回归回滚生成所主导，这部分可能超过训练时间的70%。现有的投机解码方法不太适合这种场景：基于模型的起草器会消耗稀缺的GPU内存，并可能随着策略的演进而失去对齐；而现有的免模型方法则没有显式利用训练轮次间的重复性。我们观察到，同一提示词的近期回滚结果提供了一种高质量的、自我更新的起草来源。基于这一洞察，我们提出了NgramRL，一种从有界的近期回滚历史中构建的逐提示词n-gram起草器。NgramRL不需要辅助模型、起草器训练或常驻GPU的起草器状态，同时目标模型验证保证了回滚分布不变。为了隐藏CPU缓存查找和调度的开销，我们进一步引入了自适应扇出预取器。
tldr: NgramRL利用同一提示词的近期回滚历史构建n-gram起草器进行投机解码，无需辅助模型或GPU内存开销，即可显著加速强化学习后训练中占训练时间70%以上的回滚生成过程。
en_tdlr: NgramRL accelerates RL post-training rollouts—which can exceed 70% of training time—by using a per-prompt n-gram drafter built from recent rollout history, requiring no auxiliary model while preserving the rollout distribution.
